correctness.rationale: Checked exact window/lattice normalization: Q2=(1−|t|)_+, b=2+1/(2q)+delta, a=1/(qb), fixed integer q>=2, Zak b^(-1/2)sum Q2((x−k)/b)e^(2pi i k gamma), and optimal lower A_q=min_(x,gamma) sum_{j=0}^{q−1}|Z_b(x+j/q,gamma)|² (source Zibulski–Zeevi Theorem 4). Direct finite support gives b^(3/2)Z_b(y,1/2)=(epsilon−y)_+−(y−1+epsilon)_+ for epsilon=b−2; source global zero theorem excludes other simultaneous q-sample zero phases at critical b=c_q. Thus all minimizers localize near gamma=1/2 and q-grid endpoints at epsilon0=1/(2q). Verified uniform first phase derivative is 4pi i epsilon0/c_q^(3/2), yielding O(delta) transverse phase displacement, while two edge hinges force O(delta) spatial displacement. Normalized leading energy is c_q^(−3)[(delta−h)_+²+(delta+h)_+²+(4pi²/q)tau²]+o(delta²) and its minimum is 2delta²/c_q³. Exact trial achieves upper 2delta²/(c_q+delta)^3. Independent numerical finite minimizations for q=2,3,5 and delta=0.008,0.003 attain predicted trial to floating precision and ratios approach 2/c_q³. These checks corroborate but do not replace compactness and source zero classification. No assertion uniform in q.
